text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs a cabinet meeting which discusses and agrees on an idea to set up a free trade zone in Basra, southern Iraq.
- Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz continues his meetings with Chinese officials in Beijing.
- People in Kirkuk and Ba'quba protest against cutting water flow from two big dams in northern Iraq by Kurdish rebels.
- Iraqi Trade Minister Mohammad Mehdi Saleh starts visit to Morocco.
- A supertanker docks in Umm Qasr to load with Iraqi oil under the oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- A non-governmental French organisation donates 100 tonnes of food and medicine to the Iraqi people.
